edits.old: The harness owns no table in any schema (DP-01). It reads and writes only through the published operations of section 12, and its evidence holds identifiers, statuses, confidences and timestamps only, never personal data. Field IDs are those of the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary.
edits.new:
The harness owns no table in any schema (DP-01). It reads and writes only through the published operations of section 12, and its evidence holds identifiers, statuses, confidences and timestamps only, never personal data. Field IDs are those of the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary.

The checked-fields read answers `CheckedFieldSet` (caseId, documentType, documentVersion, tableVersion, fieldCount, fields), and each `CheckedField` carries documentId, docVersion, fieldName, value, state, confidence, dataType, personal, extractorVersion and tableVersion, as RWB-P5-E2025-CON publishes them. On the treatment side, the columns contract_amount, contract_date, mortgage_amount, registration_date, land_office and title_doc_no, with source_document_id, source_doc_version, source_table_version and the tableVersion stamp of the reader's answer, belong to RWB-S2-E2025-APP. party_names stays masked as the hub returns it and is stored nowhere.

On the litigation side, RWB-S4-E2025-APP maps only the same-name codes court_name, black_case_no, red_case_no, claim_amount, judgment_date, judgment_amount and hearing_date, and filing_date to filed_date (DF-LEG-010) as a recorded name difference. The contract, credit approval and mortgage codes, party_names, notice_date, hearing_type and lawsuit_no stay unmapped on that side (GAP-1901). The harness writes none of these columns.
